articles.title: Trump says he became ‘a big crypto guy’ partly for politics
articles.snippet: US President Donald Trump once called Bitcoin “a scam,” but admitted on Monday that he got involved in crypto “a little bit for politics.”

articles.title: Morning Minute: Crypto Surges Over Holiday Weekend
articles.snippet: The ETF flows finally flip. Trump defends his billion-dollar crypto payday. And a rare set of signals says a bottom may be forming.

articles.title: Senator Gillibrand Seeks to Ban Trump, Elected Officials From Launching Meme Coins
articles.snippet: After President Trump disclosed over $1 billion in crypto-related earnings, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand is calling for a meme coin ban.
